## What changed and why?

Describe the purpose, intended result, and who or what is affected.

## What was checked?

List the checks performed and what was observed. State skipped, blocked, or inconclusive checks and important limitations just as clearly.

## Does this change scientific, data, or operational behavior?

Describe changes to assumptions, references, thresholds, identifiers, formats, data handling, external systems, or supported use. Name any new outside tool, reference, dataset, or borrowed code and where its terms are recorded. Write `No` when none apply.

## Review needed

Name the technical, data, operational, user, or scientific perspective needed for this change. Routine work does not require every kind of review.
